constraints.name: character_set_restriction
constraints.description: All strings consist only of the characters 's' and 'h'.

constraints.name: non_empty_strings
constraints.description: Every string in the sequence is non-empty.

constraints.name: mandatory_inclusion_all
constraints.description: The final concatenated string must contain all given strings exactly once, using each string in its entirety in some order.
constraints.formal: Let the multiset of input strings be S. The output permutation *(t_{π(1)}, …, t_{π(n)}) must satisfy that the concatenation t_{π(1)}…t_{π(n)} uses every string from S exactly once.
